title: Input rewind machine
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a $k$-work-tape Boolean Turing machine whose initial state is `start`. From `start` it moves the input head one position left and enters `scan`; in `scan` it moves left and remains there when the scanned input symbol is Boolean, and moves right and halts when the scanned cell is blank. In `done` it stays in that state without moving the input head; these transitions make no work-tape changes and emit no output.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number $k$ determining the number of work tapes
